routes.name: Abruzzi Spur (South-East Ridge)
routes.team: Italian expedition led by Ardito Desio; summit by Achille Compagnoni and Lino Lacedelli
routes.difficulty_notes: A steep rock ridge fixed with ropes almost all the way. House's Chimney sits just below Camp 2, the Black Pyramid's rock and ice between Camps 2 and 3, then the Bottleneck couloir and traverse beneath a hanging serac above the Shoulder. Rockfall is constant.
routes.share_of_ascents: About 75% of all K2 summits (Alan Arnette, June 2022).

camps.name: Base Camp
camps.note: Desio 1954: 16,400 ft; operators list 4,968 m; Arnette gives 5,334 m.

camps.name: Advanced Base Camp
camps.note: Madison Mountaineering 2023-25: 5,303 m; Arnette lists 5,650 m.

camps.name: Camp 4
camps.note: On the Shoulder; reported 7,600-8,000 m depending on the year.

routes.source_title: A. Arnette, K2 Winter on the Abruzzi (alanarnette.com, 2020)

routes.name: Cesen Route (South-South-East Spur)
routes.first_climbed_label: 23 June 1994 to the summit (Tomo Česen soloed it to the Shoulder in 1986)
routes.team: Basque expedition: Juanito Oiarzabal, Juan Tomás, Kike de Pablo, Alberto and Félix Iñurrategi
routes.difficulty_notes: Runs up the spur west of the Abruzzi and avoids House's Chimney and the Black Pyramid, but is steeper and more exposed to rockfall and avalanches. It joins the Abruzzi on the Shoulder at Camp 4, so both routes share the Bottleneck.

camps.name: Camp 1
camps.note: No modern figure found; a 1994 Catalan team placed C1 at 5,500 m.

camps.name: Camp 4 (the Shoulder)
camps.note: Shared with the Abruzzi; reported 7,600-8,000 m.

other_routes.name: North Ridge (from China)
other_routes.team: Japanese expedition; summit by Naoe Sakashita, Hiroshi Yoshino and Yukihiro Yanagisawa, with four more the next day
other_routes.notes: Climbed from the Chinese side. Four more team members summited the next day. Yanagisawa fell to his death on the descent.
other_routes.source_title: Late-Season K2 Summits: A History of Great Climbs and Tragedies (ExplorersWeb, 2025)

other_routes.name: Magic Line (South-Southwest Pillar)
other_routes.team: Polish-Slovak team; summit by Przemysław Piasecki, Wojciech Wróż and Petr Božik
other_routes.notes: From the Negrotto Col up the pillar on UIAA IV-V rock and steep snow and ice. Wróż died rappelling in the Bottleneck that night.

other_routes.name: Northeast Ridge (American route)
other_routes.team: Jim Whittaker's American expedition; summit by Louis Reichardt and Jim Wickwire, then John Roskelley and Rick Ridgeway
other_routes.notes: A long, corniced ridge from the upper Godwin-Austen Glacier. The third ascent of K2 and the first summits without bottled oxygen.
other_routes.source_title: K2: The End of a 40-Year American Quest (American Alpine Journal, 1979)

other_routes.name: South Face (Polish Line)
other_routes.notes: Up the centre of the south face without bottled oxygen, joining the Abruzzi for the final climb to the summit. Piotrowski fell to his death on the descent on 10 July.

other_routes.name: Southwest Ridge
other_routes.notes: A western route; the fifth ascent of K2.
